subtasks.title: Continuous Kit User Path route via CH-side sc_positions assembly (new KitRangePathsQuery) + controller swap
subtasks.approach: TDD, single coherent node (controller depends on the new query class; co-designed). (1) NEW app/Clickhouse/Queries/KitRangePathsQuery.php: read-only over clarity.sc_positions. Inner subquery = the SAME 3s decimation OrgLivePathsQuery/KitHistoricPositionsQuery use (argMin lng/lat by timestamp_utc per toStartOfInterval(timestamp_utc, INTERVAL 3 SECOND), WHERE lower(kit_mapping) IN (?) AND timestamp_utc BETWEEN ? AND ?). Outer wrap: GROUP BY mapping, toStartOfHour(ts); collect arraySort(x -> x.1, groupArray(tuple(ts_string, lng, lat))) per (mapping,hour) [arraySort is REQUIRED — groupArray does not guarantee input order]; cap each bucket array length to a private const POINTS_PER_SEGMENT_CAP=200 AFTER the sort via even-interval subsample (not naive head-truncate, so a dense/idle hour is not visually chopped). handle() then flattens the grouped rows into the exact flat list<array{mapping,lng,lat,timestamp_utc}> shape OrgLivePathsQuery::handle() returns. Ride the DB::clickhouse('sc_positions') macro (no manual clarity./FINAL — sc_positions has no ReplacingMergeTree collapse). Mirror the class-const + query(..., cache:) conventions of the sibling classes. (2) KitUserPathController::paths() ONLY: resolve org-scoped $kits -> Kit models -> private byMapping() (lower(kit_mapping) => Kit, skip null/empty mapping, mirror ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::kitsByMapping), call KitRangePathsQuery::query(['mappings'=>..., 'start'=>..., 'end'=>...], cache:true) instead of KitScanPathsQuery, feed points to the ALREADY-PUBLIC OrgLivePathsQuery::segmentByMapping($points,$timezone), map each mapping's segments back to {kit_id, name, color: KitScanPathsQuery::getColor((int)$kit->id), path, layerId: date_toggles, trip_date} — byte-identical response shape. Do NOT touch geojson()/hitDensity(). Do NOT touch KitScanPathsQuery (shared by 2 other controllers) except calling its existing public static getColor(). No JS change.
subtasks.intended_diffs: NEW KitRangePathsQuery.php (~90-130 lines, patterned on OrgLivePathsQuery + KitHistoricPositionsQuery); KitUserPathController::paths() body swapped (query class + byMapping resolver + segmentByMapping + row mapping), geojson()/hitDensity() unchanged; NEW unit test (decimation, per-kit-hour grouping row-count collapse, arraySort chronological order, 200-pt cap bounding, AC-5 single/zero-point degrade, absent-mapping = no rows); NEW feature test (permission gate, cross-org isolation, All-Kits resolution, scan-free continuous drive = non-empty path, AC-5, exact response shape).
